ends.description: The page the run is on after, by its id — or unknown

at.description: Only when failed: the step the method stopped at

message.description: What LinkedIn said, word for word: a notice, an error, an empty state

evidence.description: What the page showed, in LinkedIn's terms

outcome.description: sent: Send was clicked and Pending shows; already-pending or already-connected: nothing was sent; unavailable: the profile offers no Connect; email-required: the dialog asked for the member's email, so nothing was sent; unverified: Send was clicked but Pending did not show — never send again

sent.description: Whether Send was clicked in this call

name.description: The name the top card shows: whom the invitation went to

note.description: The note as typed, null when none
